original_source.archive_encoding: Concatenate archive_parts (the accepted English package's lossless archive, pinned repository inputs) in listed order; bytes equal the original supplied PDF. This package holds no copy of the PDF.

repository_pdf.scope: Original reference file outside the frozen Web package; not served or copied to the publication inventory.

source_authority: operator-supplied original PDF; native visible French and Spanish content; no translation or product adaptation
normalizations: Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components (callout strip, warning lockup, reference figure, App download, warranty lead and sections), in the accepted English edition's order.
Print line breaks: a line the print ended while the next word would still have fitted is kept as a line break; every other line end is a wrap (logged per language in source/<lang>/coverage.json).
Print weights: bold and semibold runs stay strong; headings keep print case; table header cells the print sets in regular weight stay regular.
Lists: numbered and bullet print items become ordered or unordered lists; asterisk notes and FCC dash lines stay as printed lines.
Tables keep the print's merged cells (row and column spans); the specification table has no header row, as printed.
Ligatures are expanded; print-split words are rejoined and logged (FR domes-/tique, automatique-/ment, immédi-/atement, alimenta/tion; ES concesion-/ario, recomien-/da, instruc-/ciones).
Two visible French lines drawn as vector outlines (p42) are restored from source/text-recovery.json.
The Spanish print repeats its p62 (PDF 64 and 65 are identical); the repeat is classified and left out.
Artwork words stay in the reviewed figure crops; the figures carry no visible caption.
